topology_rule: Retain historical G16 if native selection plans match. Otherwise within each P8 window partition nonleaders by identical native selections; largest class first, late windows first, median owned source; stop after 12 consumers. No gold or quality-based selection; exact existing allocator and online selector unchanged.

quality.dataset_status: historical full cleaned evaluation bundles; no fresh holdout claims

matrix_timing.process_scope: fresh process per arm and condition; 8 query blocks run consecutively within arm
matrix_timing.arm_order: alternate I/S then S/I by preregistered cell index
matrix_timing.interpretation: descriptive cross-task/budget timing; no claim of within-cell order-independent acceleration
matrix_timing.quality: full cleaned evaluation for each identity/shared cell, separate from cold/warm timing
